rear_wheel_load_frac_est.note: share of total weight on the 2 driven rear wheels. 0.5 if front has only 2 casters and load is centred; ~0.33 if all 4 original GFS-1830 casters were kept (6 contact points, rigid deck -> statically indeterminate, depends on wheel height vs casters); 0.25 if driven wheels sit slightly high. MEASURE with bathroom scale.

geometry.cog_note: whole loaded cart v2: lighter, lower stack -> CoG ~0.46-0.50 m above floor
geometry.track_note: GFS-1830 platform 18 in = 0.457 m wide; corner casters inset ~1-1.5 in each side -> ~0.38-0.42 m. Driven wheel track unmeasured.
geometry.wheelbase_note: platform 30 in = 0.762 m; caster centres inset ~2 in each end -> ~0.62-0.70 m. Unmeasured.
geometry.tip_note: static tip angle sideways = atan((track/2)/cog_h); lateral accel to tip = g*(track/2)/cog_h. Bear 43 in wide overhangs 18 in deck.
geometry.ball_d_note: PHOTO v2 scale check (sugar box + 3in sticky note rulers): 510 px / 0.034 in/px = 17 in = 0.44-0.50 m (was 0.65 GUESS)
geometry.bear_h_note: PHOTO v2: feet-to-head-top 1350 px -> 46 in = 1.17 m +-0.1 (listing 70 in evidently includes the stand/pole). bear_w_m (arm span in photo) 0.98 m
geometry.post_note: square steel tube, scale-estimated from ball ratio in image 3; 3/4-1 in tube typical of Spirit animatronic stands
geometry.slot_note: slot in ball top ~13 cm long x post+~3 mm wide; post sits near one end -> ~10 cm free clearance along slot, ~1-3 mm across (SEEN, scale-estimated)
geometry.bear_on_ball_cog_note: v3: bear body 6 kg at 0.47+0.45x1.2 m, frame 3.5 kg (post half at 0.55 m, base at 0.02 m), shell 1.5 kg at 0.235 m, above the deck
geometry.frame_base_note: v3: frame rail runs along the deck's long edge (SEEN a85221c3), so width ~= deck width 0.45 m; length GUESS 0.45-0.75 m; rocking half-widths b_trans 0.20-0.23, b_long 0.22-0.37
geometry.frame_gap_note: Tony: ~1 mm gap between frame and deck/ball bottom (sketch 'gap')
